page.overview:
Who is Kalifa?

Kalifa is an agent of CP0. Before the timeskip, she was an agent of CP9, operating undercover as Iceburg's secretary at the Galley-La Company. She is also Laskey's daughter and the older sister of Alpha.

She was one of the major antagonists during the Water 7 and Enies Lobby Arcs.

Kalifa is a tall, slim, and curvaceous young woman with blue eyes and glasses. Like Kuro, she often pushes up her glasses. Her strawberry-blonde hair was about shoulder-length when she first infiltrated Water 7, and she grew it out over the years she spent undercover there. She kept it tied up in a bun as a secretary, but let it fall freely when she was revealed to be an assassin.

Her height is 185 cm (6'1"), and her are B93-W61-H92 (36.61"-24.02"-36.22"), making her breasts a G-cup in Japan.
